versions.content: Upstream requirements: SRS_Os_80021 The function TryToGetSpinlock shall set the OUT parameter "Success" to TRY- TOGETSPINLOCK_SUCCESS if the spinlock was successfully occupied, and TRYTO- GETSPINLOCK_NOSUCCESS if not. In both cases E_OK shall be returned.
